summary: Several studies have directly applied transformer-based models to traffic forecasting. Chen et al. (2019) [V0221] used self-attention encoder models on the MetroFlow dataset, achieving an accuracy of 0.84. El-Sayed et al. (2021) [V0223] applied self-attention encoder models to AgriSat-4, reporting an AUROC of 0.63. Fischer et al. (2022) [V0224] evaluated self-attention encoder models on LedgerGuard, obtaining a test F1 score of 0.7. Duarte et al. (2020) [V0222] reported an MAE of 0.91 on Atlas-ICU using self-attention encoder models. Additionally, El-Sayed et al. (2021) [V0229] studied road traffic flow prediction using boosted decision-tree ensembles on MetroFlow, achieving an AUROC of 0.71.
